# carbon.calculate_Q { #cflowdist.carbon.calculate_Q }

```python
carbon.calculate_Q(G, L, I, X, FF)
```

Calculate the Q matrix based on the given formula.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type       | Description                   | Default    |
|--------|------------|-------------------------------|------------|
| G      | np.ndarray | Generation values (1D array). | _required_ |
| L      | np.ndarray | Load values (1D array).       | _required_ |
| I      | np.ndarray | Import values (1D array).     | _required_ |
| X      | np.ndarray | Export values (1D array).     | _required_ |
| FF     | np.ndarray | Flow values (2D array).       | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                    | Description                                                        |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple\[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray\] | A tuple containing the following elements: - q - Fin - Fout - Pout |
